name: Mustafa II
role: Sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1695 to 1703
contribution: The ruling sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1695 to 1703.

checks.lead: Mustafa II (; Ottoman Turkish: مصطفى ثانى Muṣṭafā-yi sānī; 6 February 1664 – 29 December 1703) was the ruling sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1695 to 1703.
